selection: Post-hoc purposive fixed case set. Two outcome labels and two earlier issue-only labels were known when this plan was adopted. This is not a random, representative, prospective or blinded-to-study-hypothesis sample.
review_scope: Extracted request, sources and complete output text for five outputs across two purchasing source families. Rendered native-file/page checks remain unverified unless actually inspected and separately recorded.
optional_metadata: Do not repeatedly ask for time or qualifications; accept volunteered actual values and retain unknowns. Only Cases1 and2 explicitly reported time not tracked.
reviewer_scope: Project owner; relevant qualifications and independence unspecified; prior issue exposure disclosed. Not independent expert validation.
stop_rule: Finish the fixed five full-content records, allowing uncertain labels. For every issue retained in the headline/pitch, record an explicit evidence-backed human disposition, source/output passage, consequence, severity/category and minimal correction. Reject, revise, qualify or remove unsupported claims. Do not add or replace cases to obtain a desired number of failures; no automatic expansion to20/35/78.
headline_issue_followups: Earlier material-correction labels remain issue-only history, not full-output outcomes. A complete content review alone does not silently create a category, evidence rationale, or minimal repair. Ask focused follow-ups only for claims to retain; all such judgments must come from the user.
prohibited_claims: Native-file/page compliance inferred from text review
allowed_claims: Case-level source/output findings actually endorsed by the human, including uncertainty and rejected flags
Descriptive case-level human/judge comparisons with invalid or missing judgments shown
Mechanical results from60attempts reported separately with their original limitations
Future private-dataset design and training hypotheses explicitly labeled untested
historical_queues: Keep the original20 calibration and35 candidate-failure queues immutable; they are supporting automated triage, not remaining mandatory work.
completion_scope: Five is an effort boundary, not a validation threshold or guarantee of assignment acceptance. No automatic assignment-complete flag; final claim review and applicant signoff remain.
